title: Forward alpha ledger row (DRAFT-UNSIGNED)
description: One row per (family, date range, alpha spent or reserved, pre-registration SHA-256). Append-only: a change is a new row whose `supersedes` names the old row_id. Owner: docs/research/model-edge-2026-10/alpha-ledger-DRAFT-2026-10-19.md.

family.description: Hypothesis family <area>/<family>. A (family, date) cell may be held by one row only.

date_start.description: First local target date, or null when not yet dated.

date_end.description: Last local target date (provisional ends say so in date_rule), or null.

date_rule.description: The non-outcome rule that fixes the dates, quoted or paraphrased from the owner.

alpha.description: Family-wise alpha of this row; null for placeholders.

multiplicity.description: e.g. single primary; Holm over k; fixed sequence; CAMPAIGN_LEDGER per-decision.

source.description: Repository-relative path or a named relay.

locator.description: Row date, section or line that carries the fact.

quote.description: Short verbatim fragment, when the fact is a quotation.
